notes: Muse variant: one interactive REPL launch runs a turn, exits cleanly (/exit -> session.end exit_reason:clean, .session.lock fd released -- live-confirmed), then relaunches as `muse resume <uuid>` in the SAME cwd. Unlike claudecode/codex/gemini-cli, muse needs NO presession-row reconciliation for this: agent.FilesUnderRoot has no presession concept (core/domain/agent/source.go), and resume physically REOPENS AND APPENDS TO THE SAME session.jsonl file at the SAME directory path -- live-verified (throwaway tmux probe, session 01a09f25-0880-7763-9990-5b13cfddca8a: 72 lines after turn 1 -> resume TUI printed 'resumed session 01a09f25...' -> 131 lines after turn 2, same file, same directory, muse's own session.resumed record present in the stream). Single-birth session model (muse's session id = directory basename, fixed at first-turn time): session_birth anchors to "start" unpinned; every later phase pins same_session_as:session_birth because muse spawns companion reminder/subagent sessions on nearly every turn (the 2-2/2-17 vacuous-pass lesson). LOAD-BEARING TIMING: the daemon's generic deletedSessions cooldown is 10s (core/application/services/session_detector_activity.go's processActivity) -- a transcript write for this session_id arriving within 10s of the daemon detecting the process exit is silently dropped rather than re-admitted; the recipe's post-exit sleep (12s) clears this with margin. Re-admission after the cooldown re-creates the row under the IDENTICAL session_id at State=ready with a fresh FirstSeen (session_detector_activity.go) -- the same mechanism already proven green on pi's committed session-resume recording (structurally identical: FilesUnderRoot, no presession, lock/cwd-based PID rediscovery). No cost is ever persisted for muse (muse-spark-* absent from the pricing catalog, corpus-wide measured fact), so cost_nonzero is false; tokens are used on every model call, so tokens_nonzero is true. Model is left unpinned -- the live probe used --provider echo's test stub and hit a resume-specific warning ('session ... does not record a usable model for provider echo'), so pinning from this probe would be a guess; record fills it from the real provider used.

text: Session appears in ready shortly after the muse TUI finishes launching (--trust-workspace skips the first-run trust dialog)
muse-bin PID (lifetime 1) bound to the session via its .session.lock held flock fd
First user prompt drives ready -> working
First turn completes back to ready (run.terminal:completed -> turn_done)
exit_clean's graceful /exit ends lifetime 1 -- process_exited on the session (.session.lock fd released, session.end exit_reason:clean on disk)

Spec: 'Same session_id reappears (not a new session row)' -- muse resume <uuid> relaunches in the SAME cwd and reopens/appends to the SAME session.jsonl file; activity resumes on the SAME session_id under a new PID, no second session row is ever created
Second lifetime's prompt drives the SAME session to working
Second turn completes back to ready on the SAME session_id -- each PID lifetime's arc is independently correct, and the run ends in ready
